catalogue.note: Normalised copy of mobile/inherited-11 with the shared iPhone chrome. The 560×877 inside is scaled 0.7179 to 402 wide and cut once at y=762: the part above is pinned to the top, the part below to the bottom, the 148px between filled with the inside’s own background. Nothing inside is restyled. Frame chrome is left off: the 32px corner radius and the 2px green ring, which Figma strokes outside this frame, so its export is 564×881 while the screen is the 560 frame alone. Diff is on the shared region (the export's inner 560 box, less its outer 3px and four corner squares). IBM Plex Sans Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold and Bold Italic are embedded from the installed static TTFs (3.201). SF Symbols are the outlines from Figma's own SVG export of this frame (SF Pro cannot be shipped). Text set at 12, 15, 16 and 20px sits 1px higher than the export: Chrome rounds the half-pixel of leading down, Figma rounds it up; left as is, not nudged.
